nodes.label: AGENTS.md — Agent Memory
nodes.rationale: Central agent memory documenting domain, architecture, roles, and critical gotchas for the MNCH Mentorship Platform.

nodes.label: MNCH Mentorship Platform
nodes.rationale: Laravel 12 + Filament v3 production web application for managing healthcare training and mentorship programs in Kenya.

nodes.label: Two Training Types Domain Split
nodes.rationale: Training model discriminates global_training (centralized MOH trainings) from facility_mentorship (on-site mentorships). Central architectural concept.

nodes.label: Kenya Geographic Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Division -> County -> Subcounty -> Facility. User access scoped via pivot tables county_user, subcounty_user, facility_user.

nodes.label: Spatie RBAC Roles
nodes.rationale: 15+ Spatie roles including super_admin, facility_mentor, mentee, etc. Permissions generated via Filament Shield.

nodes.label: Knowledge Base / Resources
nodes.rationale: Public resource center with public/authenticated/restricted visibility controlled by HasAccessControl trait.

nodes.label: Inventory / Commodities
nodes.rationale: Healthcare commodity inventory, batches, stock requests/transfers, low-stock alerts.

nodes.label: Analytics & Reporting
nodes.rationale: Filament widgets, controller dashboards, Kenya county heatmaps, monthly report generation.

nodes.label: Service Layer
nodes.rationale: Complex business logic centralized in app/Services/: TrainingAnalyticsService, AssessmentScoringService, EnrollmentService, etc.

nodes.label: Mobile API in Flux
nodes.rationale: Growing /api/v1 mobile API layer with known backend risks: conflict markers, enrollment rule mismatches, missing endpoints.
